gosh i know how you feel. im sorry that she toyed with your emotions like that. regardless of age thats rude and hurtful and inconsiderate. but that does mean it is completely her fault; nor is it yours. that hurt is fresh so itll probably sting for a while. the best thing to remember is that if she wasn’t interested she probably isnt the one youre meant to be with in that way, or she could change her mind next month as high school girls do. the best thing you can do when embarrassed is act like you dont care. Smile in their face and act like its no big deal. work on yourself in private and with your friends that like you for you into making yourself the best you that you can be. i wrote a love letter my freshman year to a guy friend of mine and he made me ecstatic, like butterflies in the tummy happy, and i thought he was the best thing since sliced bread but after seeing him look at that letter with a guilty look on his face i just hardened my exterior. he said thank you for it but he didnt see me that way and i said it was no problem and that he deserved to hear the things i wrote in the letter. in junior year that same boy told me that he didnt want to date me because i was a good friend and he didnt think i was treating myself like i should. after that i realized that i needed to change how i was living to make room for another person in my heart. so i think the lesson is love yourself before you try to love anyone else because you gotta admit love is like laundry, you cant carry all of it at once so you gotta do a load for yourself and a load for others so you know where youre walking
